rows.commentary: 4.6: Arshdeep Singh fires a 134kph yorker right into the blockhole well outside off, leaving Finn Allen reaching into the tramline with no avail.
5.1: Prince Yadav delivers a 131kph good length ball on off, and Glenn Phillips opens the face to guide it straight to short third man.
5.2: Prince Yadav tests Phillips with a hard length that rears off the surface, drawing an ambitious, swinging miss from the clearing batter.
5.3: Prince Yadav floats out an 110kph slower ball on a length outside off, allowing Phillips to launch it handsomely for an 84-meter maximum over long-off.
5.4: Prince Yadav pushes a very full delivery into Phillips, who drives it firmly to mid-off where a slight fumble from Shreyas Iyer keeps them scoreless.
5.5: Prince Yadav serves up a length ball that Phillips wristily heaves over wide mid-on, racing past a chasing Arshdeep Singh and all the way to the boundary rope.

5.6: Prince Yadav misses his yorker at 132kph and strays straight, letting Glenn Phillips tuck it fine to the fence to cap a 14-run over and bring up New Zealand's highest powerplay score of the series at 67/2.
6.1: Nitish Reddy angles one in from over the wicket on a short of a good length, cramming Finn Allen for room as an inside edge pings into the pad.
6.2: Nitish Reddy drifts a 125kph low full toss into the pads, safely flicked away through the midwicket region for a single.
6.3: Nitish Reddy errs with a full 127kph delivery onto the pads, and Glenn Phillips ruthlessly whips it away to the long leg boundary for four.
6.4: Nitish Reddy brings a 132kph in-seamer back sharply to beat Phillips on the inside and ping him high on the front pad.
6.5: Nitish Reddy loses control on a wayward shortish delivery that sails harmlessly and wide down the tramlines far outside off.
6.5: Nitish Reddy serves it at 131kph, pitching short of a good length wide of off before Glenn Phillips stays back and steers it toward deep point for a single.
6.6: Nitish Reddy keeps it tidy at 130kph, and Finn Allen shifts back and across to work it through the midwicket pocket.
7.1: Axar Patel darts a 94kph delivery into the pads from round the wicket, prompting Finn Allen to back away and glance it fine as Mayank escorts the ball to the fence.
7.2: Axar Patel delivers the ball that brings up a hard-earned fifty partnership for the batting side.
16.5: Mayank Yadav drops it short and slow, allowing Michael Bracewell to swivel deep in the crease and whip it over long leg for a maximum that seals another brutal assault.
16.6: Mayank Yadav finally lands a searing yorker outside off at 138kph, beating Bracewell completely to wrap up a bruising 20-run over that leaves his figures at 4-0-48-3.
17.1: Prince Yadav serves up a low full toss around off, which Glenn Phillips drags off the inner half down to long-on for a single.
17.2: Prince Yadav pierces the pads with a full and straight delivery as Michael Bracewell misses his lap sweep, sealing an lbw dismissal confirmed by three reds on review for a brilliant 65.
17.3: Prince Yadav fires in a 133kph full pitcher outside off, allowing Mitchell Santner to drive wide of long-off and scamper back for a brace.
17.4: Prince Yadav tests the channel with a 130kph delivery just inside the wide marker, which Mitchell Santner aggressively flashes at and misses.
17.5: Prince Yadav drops a low full toss outside off that Mitchell Santner toe-ends over mid-off, scampering through for a single.
17.6: Prince Yadav digs in a slower bouncer that sails too high over Glenn Phillips, drawing an immediate wide call from the umpire.
17.6: Prince Yadav spears in a 129kph yorker near off-stump, and Glenn Phillips digs it out toward long-on to retain the strike.
18.1: Arshdeep Singh strays full and outside off, stretching Glenn Phillips to the limit before the umpire signals it wide right on the guideline.
18.1: Arshdeep Singh loses his radar entirely, hurling one well wide of the guideline as Glenn Phillips ignores it completely.
18.1: Arshdeep Singh gifts a third consecutive wide to pile the pressure right back on the bowling side.
4.1: Matthew Fisher drops it short, and Abhishek Sharma unleashes a ferocious pull shot, sending the ball soaring over square leg into the stands for his first maximum.
4.2: Matthew Fisher offers width on a back-of-a-length delivery, allowing Abhishek Sharma to play a flat-bat stroke that clears mid-off for four.
4.3: Matthew Fisher fires a 143kph delivery down the leg side, past Abhishek Sharma's attempted glance, signaling a wide.
4.3: Matthew Fisher strikes with a 143kph cross-seamer that catches the splice of Abhishek Sharma's bat, looping an easy catch to Mitchell Santner at mid-off.
4.4: Matthew Fisher jams an inswimmer into the body, and Axar Patel's nudge to mid-wicket is wisely rejected by Iyer.
4.5: Matthew Fisher strays too straight on middle and leg, permitting Axar Patel to clip it away toward deep square leg for a single.
4.6: Matthew Fisher delivers a 141kph short-of-length ball, which Shreyas Iyer handles by riding the bounce to steer it down to third man.
5.1: Adam Milne targets the upper body with a 141kph short delivery, and Shreyas Iyer gets behind the line to block it back down.
5.2: Adam Milne attacks the stumps with a full delivery, and a hurried Shreyas Iyer inside-edges it fine for a fortuitous boundary.
5.3: Adam Milne rattles the top of leg-stump with a 139kph skiddy delivery, cleaning up Shreyas Iyer and sparking a fierce roar of celebration.
5.4: Adam Milne digs it short of a good length outside off, allowing Nitish Reddy to play it late past slip for a single.
5.5: Adam Milne pitches fuller outside off, and Axar Patel can only mistime his drive straight toward the fielder at mid-off.
5.6: Adam Milne offers a good length slanted away, and Axar Patel forcefully slices his drive through the cover gap to find the ropes.
6.1: Matthew Fisher keeps it tight, inviting Nitish Reddy to nudge a simple single toward mid-on.
